notes:
I couldn't do this research. My search and fetch tool stopped working before it returned any pages: each attempt to open a source, starting with Enduring Word's Proverbs 8 page, came back with an error saying I had no tool calls left. The other tools I have can't go online.

You asked me to report only what the pages say, with a URL for every point. Since I didn't read any pages, I have no notes for any verse, and I haven't written any from memory.

When the tool is available again, in a new message or after the limit resets, I'll start with these pages:

- **Verse-by-verse traditional reading:** enduringword.com/bible-commentary/proverbs-8/, the Biblehub pages for each verse (biblehub.com/commentaries/proverbs/8-1.htm to 8-36.htm, which include Gill, Ellicott and the Pulpit Commentary), and Precept Austin's Proverbs 8 page.
- **Where Protestant traditions differ:** whether Wisdom in vv. 22–31 is Christ or a figure of speech (Got Questions, Ligonier, Desiring God, Wesley's notes on wesley.nnu.edu, Spurgeon's sermons, Lutheran sources).
- **Other views:**
  - NET Bible notes on the Hebrew word translated "created" in v. 22 and on "craftsman" in v. 30
  - Bible Odyssey on Lady Wisdom
  - The Church Fathers' arguments with the Arians over v. 22, such as Athanasius on newadvent.org
  - Catholic and Orthodox readings of Wisdom as the Logos
  - What these sites say about reading vv. 18–21 ("riches… enduring wealth… making their treasuries full") as a promise of prosperity

Just reply "try again" and I'll run the research.
